sloka: स च वाग्भिः प्रशन्ताभिर्गमिष्यन् पूजितस्तया ।तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य चिन्तयामास वानरः ।। ५.४१.१।।।।
transliteration: sa ca vāgbhiḥ praśantābhirgamiṣyan pūjitastayā ।tasmāddeśādapakramya cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ ।। 5.41.1।।।।

translations.english: Having been honoured and praised by Sita's words, Hanuman prepared to depart from Sita's presence.
